candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record specifies a congenital cholesteatoma (no prior ear disease, hypoplastic petrous bone, OMS background, no history of perforation or prior ear surgery predisposing to acquired cholesteatoma) with fistula formation in the setting of OMS. C001 correctly identifies middle ear cholesteatoma with fistula but does not specify the congenital subtype nor the OMS etiology/setting, both of which are required components of the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures cholesteatoma with fistula but omits the congenital qualifier and the otomandibular syndrome context required by the benchmark

case_quality_flags: Congenital vs acquired cholesteatoma distinction is clinically important here given the OMS and temporal bone hypoplasia context; the record supports congenital subtype.
